Part of <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3fc10ae18c9f8158abd7e59528eee0a6">Shanivar Product Thesis — Protection, Awareness & Flow</mention-page>. Scope: **first release only**. Owner: Frontend lead. Last updated: <mention-date start="2026-10-17"/>.
## Objective
Make the move from protection to intentional action intuitive, reliable and low-friction on native Android.
## Top work items (first release)
1. First-action flow: a new user completes one meaningful action without configuring everything ([DEV-73](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-73), [DEV-24](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-24), [DEV-26](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-26))
2. Block overlay: show why the intervention appeared and record the choice on-device ([DEV-69](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-69), [DEV-68](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-68), [DEV-10](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-10))
3. Missed-step recovery and non-punitive return ([DEV-74](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-74))
4. Protection failure surfacing: service killed, permission revoked ([DEV-70](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-70), [DEV-67](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-67))
5. Stage 1 practice with audio built into the practice; Sadhana screens S1–S7 ([DEV-36](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-36), [DEV-37](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-37), [DEV-27](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-27)–[DEV-33](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-33)); fix the breathing content ([DEV-39](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-39), [DEV-89](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-89))
6. Sync wiring, guest sign-in and build flavours ([DEV-47](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-47), [DEV-44](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-44)); loading, empty, error, permission-denied and offline states; instrument the DEV-65 events
## Acceptance criteria and definition of done
- A first-time user finishes one meaningful action with no full setup.
- The user can tell why the intervention appeared and what each choice does.
- A missed action never creates a loop or an unrecoverable state; a failed request never shows success.
- Each event fires once per action, with no rerender duplicates (verified by DEV-83).
- No breath pacing, no claims, no teacher names; TalkBack and 200% font pass.
- **DoD:** code review, unit and UI tests, docs, telemetry, the QA suite passes on real devices.
## Alignment review: answer by the next weekly status
1. What must change?
2. What already exists?
3. What is missing?
4. What are the dependencies and risks?
5. What can ship in the first release?
6. How will the result be verified?
Record any major interpretation of the thesis in the thesis Decision log before building.

Part of <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3fc10ae18c9f8158abd7e59528eee0a6">Shanivar Product Thesis — Protection, Awareness & Flow</mention-page>. Scope: **first release only**. Owner: Backend lead. Last updated: <mention-date start="2026-10-17"/>.
## Objective
Give the behavior-change loop a dependable, secure and measurable foundation on Supabase `shanivar-prototype` (ap-south-1). Supabase is the only backend; no frontend hosting.
## Top work items (first release)
1. Single-backend decision and staging project, plan and backups ([DEV-40](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-40), [DEV-41](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-41))
2. RLS hardening and a cross-user access test suite for every table, RPC and function ([DEV-42](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-42), [DEV-79](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-79))
3. Event dictionary, analytics contract and WIAC computation ([DEV-65](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-65))
4. Idempotent routine completion and sync engine ([DEV-72](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-72), [DEV-45](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-45), [DEV-38](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-38), [DEV-52](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-52), [DEV-53](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-53), [DEV-54](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-54), [DEV-50](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-50))
5. Auth: guest plus invite-gated email OTP; delete-account ([DEV-48](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-48), [DEV-46](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-46))
6. Migrations and functions through CI; logging, retention and backup review; runbook ([DEV-43](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-43), [DEV-80](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-80), [DEV-81](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-81)); credential rotation with the founder ([DEV-8](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-8))
## Acceptance criteria and definition of done
- No user can read or modify another user's rows (pgTAP plus integration tests).
- Repeated requests never duplicate completions or rewards (idempotency keys, unique constraints).
- Failures are observable (dead-letter, logs) and recoverable.
- No secrets or sensitive data appear in responses, analytics or logs; keys never live in git.
- Every migration is CI-applied and tested, and reversible where feasible; every endpoint documents success, validation and failure.
- **DoD:** review, tests, API docs, monitoring, a rollback note.

2. What already exists?
3. What is missing?
4. What are the dependencies and risks?
5. What can ship in the first release?
6. How will the result be verified?

Part of <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3fc10ae18c9f8158abd7e59528eee0a6">Shanivar Product Thesis — Protection, Awareness & Flow</mention-page>. Scope: **first release only**. Owner: QA lead. Last updated: <mention-date start="2026-10-17"/>.
## Objective
Verify Shanivar independently across normal, failure and recovery scenarios. Never rely on developer confirmation alone.
## Top work items (first release)
1. Traceable test plan, AC-to-test matrix and defect register ([DEV-82](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-82))
2. Physical-device protocol for protection and alarms, including OEM battery savers, reboot, Doze, DST and process death ([DEV-7](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-7), [DEV-71](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-71), [DEV-75](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-75))
3. End-to-end protect → act → reflect journey and regression suite ([DEV-84](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-84), [DEV-55](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-55))
4. Analytics-versus-actual-actions verification ([DEV-83](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-83))
5. Authz boundaries, duplicate requests and input validation, with Backend ([DEV-79](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-79)); the no-breath-pacing audit ([DEV-89](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-89))
6. CI gate ([DEV-15](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-15)); a release recommendation for each RC
## Acceptance criteria and definition of done
- Every acceptance criterion maps to a reproducible test case with evidence.
- Alarm and protection features are verified on real devices (at least one Xiaomi/Realme/Vivo/Samsung class device plus a Pixel), not only emulators.
- Regression passes before every RC; analytics are verified.
- No unresolved critical or high defect remains without documented founder approval.
- **DoD:** a feature is done when its ACs, integration and regression pass, not when it appears on screen.

## Objective
Find out whether users reach the intended outcome, and why they struggle, disengage or return.
## Top work items (first release)
1. Segment definitions and an activation milestone per segment (distraction, routine, meditation, self-inquiry) ([DEV-66](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-66))
2. Baseline plan for activation, W1/W4 and WIAC once DEV-65 lands ([DEV-85](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-85))
3. Interview guide, feedback and churn-reason taxonomy, monthly product review ([DEV-86](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-86), [DEV-49](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-49))
4. Map each initial practice to a user need and expected action ([DEV-76](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-76))
5. Closed-test cohort (12+ testers × 14 days) interviews: active, inactive, returning
## Acceptance criteria and definition of done
- Each segment has a measurable activation definition, agreed with Product.
- Findings separate behavior from self-report and state their limits.
- Every recommendation links to a ticket.
- Higher engagement is never reported as proof of awareness.
- **DoD:** dashboard spec, interview guide and first insights report delivered.

Part of <mention-page url="https://app.notion.com/p/3fc10ae18c9f8158abd7e59528eee0a6">Shanivar Product Thesis — Protection, Awareness & Flow</mention-page>. Scope: **first release only**. Owner: Marketing lead. Last updated: <mention-date start="2026-10-17"/>.
## Objective
Communicate "Protect. Become Aware. Enter Flow." accurately and attract users whose problems Shanivar solves.
## Top work items (first release)
1. Positioning and messaging doc, plus a feature-claim verification checklist ([DEV-88](https://shanivar.atlassian.net/browse/DEV-88))
2. Plain explanation of how protection, routine and awareness relate; separate messages for distraction, routines and meditation adherence
3. Align landing page, onboarding, store listing and launch comms with the actual first-release features and limits
4. A test of whether people understand the promise before any larger campaign (no spend without founder approval)
## Acceptance criteria and definition of done
- No medical, therapeutic, energy or guaranteed-performance claims; no "impossible to bypass".
- No teacher or lineage named; a translator credit (for example Wallis) is fine; "33 sections" is fine.
- Every claim is checked against the feature-verification page and platform limits (browser and other devices are not blocked; brief flash).
- Success is the share of acquired users who activate and reach a first goal, not clicks or installs.
- **Note:** wider Marketing has no epic yet (founder Q4).

## Objective
Keep Shanivar financially viable without monetisation undermining trust.
## Top work items (first release)
1. Unit-economics model and monthly opex forecast (see the Finance model request page)
2. Cost per activated and per retained user, with explicit assumptions
3. Pricing and monetisation scenarios; a free-vs-paid boundary that never paywalls essential controls, stop or privacy
4. Cost-risk register: notifications, usage growth, AI (only if Gemini is kept; currently it is not in the first release)
## Acceptance criteria and definition of done
- Every number carries a source or a labelled assumption.
- Prices are not set from competitors alone; willingness to pay is validated with target users.
- Essential controls and privacy are not weakened for conversion.
- **DoD:** model, assumption register and opex forecast reviewed with the founder.
- **Note:** Finance has no epic or tickets yet (founder Q4).
